title: The desktop window takes its look from a theme; organization theme and name from the data folder
spec: crewcraft_desktop_ui::appearance::style(theme, variant) maps every theme token to egui's style: text and muted text, bg-pane (panels), surface (windows, idle widgets), surface-hover, bg-canvas (text fields), link, warning, danger, accent-soft (selection), accent-pressed and on-accent (pressed widgets), focus-ring, stroke and stroke-strong; radius-s for widgets, radius-m for menus, radius-l for windows; size-small, size-body (body, buttons, monospace) and size-title (headings); compact density tightens spacing. A theme without a dark palette draws its light one in dark mode. Appearance::install sets the light and dark styles and the mode (system, light or dark). parse_settings reads appearance.toml ([appearance] theme, mode, organization of 1 to 64 printable characters), refusing unknown sections and keys and bad values with the line. Appearance::resolve takes the settings text and an optional theme addon (crewcraft_theme::load_addon: format, contrast, not a built-in id); anything refused is reported in words and the default theme applies, never part of a file. The desktop app reads appearance.toml and theme-addon.toml from its data folder (regular files only, size limits, UTF-8), installs the look, shows the organization's name instead of CrewCraft in the title bar and on the sign-in heading, and shows the problems as the window's notice.
